title: Jr. Critical Infrastructure Engineer
reason: Stack +4; Title fit +12; Entry +15; Exp fit +10; US +10
description_preview:
DataBank Holdings Ltd.
is a leading provider of enterprise-class data center, cloud, and interconnection services, offering customers 100% uptime availability of data, applications, and infrastructure. DataBank’s managed data center services are anchored in world-class facilities. Our customized technology solutions are designed to help customers effectively manage risk, improve technology performance, and allow focus on core business objectives. DataBank is headquartered in the historic former Federal Reserve Bank Building, in downtown Dallas, TX.
DataBank is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our work culture at DataBank does not discriminate based on actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, lineage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability or handicap, sex, marital status, veterans' status, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
As a Jr. Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring 100% uptime of our data center operations, supporting mission-critical infrastructure for both the company and our customers. This position reports on-site and works closely with senior engineering staff and site operations teams to maintain, support, and optimize all technical aspects of facility operations.
Key Responsibilities:
Monitor and review maintenance methods, standards, and operating procedures for all facility equipment.
Collaborate with the Chief Engineer to plan and execute customer solutions, including space, power, and cooling requirements.
Support the daily operations of critical infrastructure systems—including power, HVAC, and life safety equipment—ensuring optimal performance and rapid incident response.
Assist in generating and maintaining up-to-date facility and compliance reports.
Provide technical support during customer installations and integrations, ensuring successful project completion.
Address operational issues promptly to uphold our commitment to 100% uptime.
Liaise effectively with operations management, vendors, and stakeholders to implement and track solutions.
Qualifications:
1-3 years of experience in facility operations within data centers, telecommunications, or similar mission-critical environments.
Familiarity with maintenance management and ticketing software platforms.
Capable of working in high-pressure, high-availability (24/7/365) environments, including vendor coordination and emergency response.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Foundational knowledge of mission-critical facility systems, including Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), generators, mechanical, and fire safety systems.
Understanding of building automation systems, energy management, and control systems for mechanical and electrical infrastructure.
Strong multi-tasking and time management skills; ability to meet shifting deadlines.
Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, and MS PowerPoint.
Benefits:
Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
Company-paid Life Insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
Compensation:
Salary range: $75,000 – $90,000 (commensurate with experience), plus full benefits package.

title: Associate Project Engineer
reason: Stack +19; Title fit +6; Entry +15; US +10
description_preview:
Description
POSITION DESCRIPTION:
The Associate Project Engineer will assist in providing technical support during the project origination and development phases for community solar scale PV+ESS, PV-only, or ESS-only projects across the United States. The Associate Project Engineer will support the Development and Project Engineering teams throughout various stages of the project. This position will involve gaining experience in project-level technical due diligence, project development engineering, EPC engineering oversight, construction support, and project risk analysis.. This role is based in our Offices in Irvine or San Francisco CA.
Responsibilities
Assist with technical due diligence to support the origination and development team for projects at various stages of development, both before and after project award.
Help prepare conceptual layouts and electrical single-line diagrams for various opportunities.
Support system energy modeling and energy estimates using tools such as PVsyst and Helioscope to ensure production targets are reasonable for both short-term and long-term goals.
Assist in updating system engineering throughout the project development process to optimize financial outcomes.
Participate in technology reviews for PV or ESS equipment and collaborate with manufacturers to assess acceptability for use in long-term operating assets.
Provide technical assistance to the Project Engineering team in support of stakeholders' interests, including investors, site owners, utilities, off-takers, and EPC partners.
Visit project sites to assist in collecting key project technical information, such as site structures, electrical drawings, site electricity load data, and costs.
Work with the origination and development team to contribute to engineering deliverables for key development items, which may include preparing preliminary layouts, technology selection, site studies, feasibility studies, interconnection applications, and project cost estimation.
Support the sourcing and management of external consultants, partners, contractors, and vendors, including assisting in developing Scope of Work documents, managing RFP processes, and controlling scope and scheduling to obtain similar deliverables.
Perform other duties and special projects as assigned by management.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, or energy engineering science.
Experience in solar or ESS project engineering (internships or entry-level positions are acceptable).
Ability to review engineering and technical matters with a commercial perspective.
Familiarity with ground-mountand battery storageprojects in distributed generation.
Comfortable working with various project stakeholders, including EPC partners, developers, consultants, and O&M contractors.
Experience with permitting processes with local authorities and utilities.
Proficiency in engineering software and energy modeling applications, such as AutoCAD,HelioScope, PVsyst, and Microsoft Office tools.
Preferred Qualifications
Able to cope with dynamic surroundings and be team-oriented
Able todevelopwritten/verbal work deliverables that are organized and appropriate to therespectiveaudience
Hanwha Q CELLS America Inc. (“HQCA”) is a Qcells company, one of the world’s largest manufacturers and providers of solar photovoltaic (PV) products and solutions. Headquartered in Irvine, California, HQCA has been rapidly expanding its business in North America through the expansion of products and solutions, including distributed energy solutions, direct-to-homeowner solar sales and financing, and EPC services. We provide an opportunity to be part of an exciting and growing world-class global business in an interesting and expanding industry of the future.

description_preview:
Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.
Overview
This role will primarily support the billing system, including production incident handling, application change requests, and overnight support. Validates requirements and performs analysis and design for system improvements and new applications. Represents the department by leading work and providing guidance to others.
Note: This is a hybrid role and we have 8 Paychex strategic locations to chose from.
Responsibilities
Support the billing system, including production incidents, application change requests, and overnight support
Develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software to meet requirements
Design and develop test automation code
Complete complex program changes in a self-directed manner
Perform comprehensive analysis and design for broadly defined requirements
Make significant technical contributions and contribute to technical direction
Provide estimates for user stories based on business requirements, specifications, and designs
Comply with and contribute to SDLC standards and CI/CD procedures to ensure consistency; identify and introduce opportunities for improvement
Monitor progress against task estimates and provide status updates
Provide technical support and troubleshooting for applications across environments, including high-impact production issues
Maintain existing code base and monitor for failures in non-production environments
Support changes during quality assurance, user acceptance testing, and post-implementation to ensure application integrity
Share technical expertise; guide and mentor others to maximize team effectiveness and quality
Serve as a subject matter expert in a relevant technology or business application
Leverage AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to support agentic development and improve productivity
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in a computer-related discipline or equivalent work experience
5 years of experience in a related field
Demonstrated project leadership experience
Experience using one or more programming language(s)
Skills
Troubleshooting and problem solving
Production support
Leadership
Communication
Agile methodology
Java programming language
Application Programming Interface (API) / RESTful microservices
Relational database experience, such as Oracle
NoSQL database experience, such as MongoDB
Enterprise data pipelines, such as Kafka
Familiarity with AI development tools for agentic development
Compensation
In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share that the starting base pay range for this position is $93,590 - $147,070 annually. Please keep in mind that this range is the base pay only and does not consider other components that make up the total rewards package for the position. If you are hired at Paychex, your overall compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience which may result in total compensation outside of this range.
Live the Paychex Values
Act with uncompromising integrity.
Provide outstanding service and build trusted relationships.
Drive innovation in our products and services and continually improve our processes.
Work in partnership and support each other.
Be personally accountable and deliver on commitments.
Treat each other with respect and dignity.
What's in it for you?
We value your well-being: We provide over 21 comprehensive rewards, including medical coverage, virtual wellness classes, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) + employer match, adoption assistance, financial assistance, and much more.
We value your time: From paid time off to company holidays, culture days, and comprehensive work-life balance programs, we will ensure you have the flexibility you need to be your best.
We value your development: Our award-winning training and development programs empower our employees with ongoing learning opportunities to give you the building blocks to grow your career.
We value your perspective: Our company culture reflects the diversity of our employees. We want you to be you and your voice to be heard.
We value our communities: We offer paid time off for volunteerism and promote many company-wide and local initiatives that benefit organizations you care about.
Note: The benefits described apply to full-time employees. Benefits for part-time, contract, and intern roles may vary.
Not sure if you meet every requirement?
At Paychex, we know that great talent comes in many forms. If you're passionate about the role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the right fit - either for this position or another opportunity with us.
Paychex is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a respectful and inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated fairly and evaluated based on their qualifications, experience, and merit. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws prohibiting discrimination in employment.

title: Java Full Stack Developer
reason: Stack +58; Title fit +12; Title stack +4; US +10; Overqualified -45
description_preview:
Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced
Full Stack Java Developer,
you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite client service delivery.
Recruiting for this role ends on 9/11/20206
Work You'll Do/Responsibilities
As a Full Stack Java Spring Boot Developer, you will design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications and microservices that integrate with REST APIs and databases. In this client-facing Consultant role, you will collaborate with technical teams, product stakeholders, and clients to deliver secure, high-performing solutions aligned with business objectives. You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle while supporting Agile delivery, continuous improvement, and high-quality engineering practices. Deloitte's Java capabilities emphasize cloud-native development, microservices, REST, Spring, relational and NoSQL databases, and DevOps practices. 1
Build and maintain full-stack applications using Java 11/17+, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, and Spring Security.
Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and distribute microservices using clean, scalable, and testable design patterns.
Create responsive, accessible user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Design and optimize database integrations using SQL, Hibernate/JPA, and Spring Data with relational and NoSQL databases.
Implement application security practices, including OAuth2, JWT, encryption, and secure handling of sensitive data.
Support CI/CD and cloud deployment activities using Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and automated testing.
Communicate effectively with client and internal stakeholders, translating business needs into practical technical solutions.
Adjust and align working hours, as needed, to support client teams and collaboration across EST and CST time zones.
Design and develop new backend API functionality to enhance specialist referral performance and user experience
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others
The Team
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.
Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
Qualifications
Required
4-8 years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on full-stack web application development in a client-facing, consulting, or delivery environment.
4+ years of experience developing applications with Java and the Spring ecosystem, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, and Spring Security.
3+ years of experience designing, developing, or consuming RESTful APIs and working with microservices or distributed application architectures.
3+ years of experience building applications that integrate with relational databases through SQL, Hibernate/JPA, Spring Data, or comparable ORM technologies.
2+ years of experience developing responsive front-end applications using JavaScript or TypeScript and at least one modern framework, such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
2+ years of experience writing unit and integration tests using tools such as JUnit, Mockito, or TestNG, along with experience participating in peer code reviews.
1+ year of experience with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, or cloud deployment technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, or GCP.
1+ year of experience working in Agile delivery environments, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and iterative client delivery..
Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Candidates must be at least 18 years of age at the time of employment
Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Preferred
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Analytical/ Decision Making Responsibilities
Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products
Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
Excellent Written and Communication Skills

title: TIBCO BusinessWorks Developer
reason: Stack +48; Title fit +6; US +10; Overqualified -45
description_preview:
Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced
Tibco BusinessWorks Developer
you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite client service delivery.
Recruiting for this role ends on 9/4/2026
Work You'll Do/Responsibilities
The project focuses on designing, developing, deploying, and optimizing middleware solutions that connect banking applications, databases, APIs, messaging platforms, and other enterprise systems.
The Consultant will contribute to integration delivery across TIBCO ActiveMatrix BusinessWorks environments, including BW 5.x, BW 6.x, and BusinessWorks Container Edition. The role requires collaboration with distributed teams and flexibility to align working hours with Eastern or Central time zones.
Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise integrations using TIBCO ActiveMatrix BusinessWorks 5.x, 6.x, and/or BusinessWorks Container Edition.
Develop and support RESTful and SOAP-based web services for secure and reliable communication across enterprise applications.
Implement asynchronous, event-driven integrations using TIBCO Enterprise Message Service, Apache Kafka, and/or IBM MQ.
Build data transformation and mapping logic using XML, XSD, XSLT, XPath, JSON, and WSDL.
Integrate middleware solutions with relational databases such as Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server.
Write and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and database triggers to support integration workflows.
Monitor integration flows and troubleshoot production issues, including latency, memory leaks, thread contention, and message-processing failures.
Tune TIBCO engine and JVM parameters to improve integration performance, scalability, and reliability.
Implement robust error-handling, logging, alerting, retry, and recovery mechanisms.
Support software delivery automation using Git, Maven, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or comparable CI/CD tools.
Participate in peer code reviews and apply established integration design patterns, coding standards, and quality practices.
Collaborate with architects, business analysts, developers, testers, infrastructure teams, and client stakeholders in an Agile delivery environment.
Support unit testing, debugging, deployment validation, and defect resolution using TIBCO Designer and/or Business Studio.
Contribute to the modernization of legacy integrations through microservices, containerization, and cloud-enabled delivery approaches.
Align work hours as needed with Eastern or Central time zone teams and project ceremonies.
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others
The Team
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.
Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
Required
Qualifications
4+ years of experience in professional software engineering, enterprise application integration, middleware development, or a related technical discipline.
4+ years of experience developing integrations with TIBCO ActiveMatrix BusinessWorks 5.x and/or 6.x, including hands-on experience with TIBCO Enterprise Message Service.
3+ years of experience designing, developing, consuming, and troubleshooting REST and SOAP web services using HTTP/S, FTP, and SFTP.
3+ years of experience working with XML, XSD, XSLT, XPath, JSON, WSDL, and complex data transformation or mapping requirements.
2+ years of experience integrating middleware solutions with enterprise databases using SQL, stored procedures, or database triggers, and supporting CI/CD delivery through tools such as Git, Maven, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
Candidates must be at least 18 years of age at the time of employment
Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Preferred
2+ years of experience with TIBCO BusinessWorks Container Edition, Docker, Kubernetes, or microservices modernization.
2+ years of experience delivering technology solutions for financial services, banking, insurance, capital markets, wealth management, or FinTech organizations.
2+ years of experience developing or supporting solutions that process sensitive data, including PII or NPI, with security controls such as SSL/TLS and OAuth2.
1+ year of experience supporting security reviews, pen

Love building from scratch.

About Us
Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.
From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place.
Grow a Career. Build a Future!
Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.
Job Purpose
The Offsite Validation - Test Engineer is an entry-level engineering role responsible for supporting lab and field validation of crop harvesting equipment in actual and simulated operating conditions. This position assists with test execution, machine evaluations, data collection, issue documentation, and communication of findings to support product performance, reliability, durability, customer value, and development decision-making. Position is based out of New Holland, PA.
Key Responsibilities
Responsibilities Include:
Support Validation Specialists and senior test engineers with execution of Integrated Validation Plan activities, including test preparation, machine operation, data collection, issue documentation, and follow-up actions.
Assist with lab and field whole-vehicle evaluations on combine/header projects and contribute to the development of results, observations, and recommendations for product improvement.
Evaluate operational performance of pre-production test vehicles, components, and subsystems under guidance from experienced engineers.
Assist with instrumentation, data acquisition, and measurement activities involving noise, vibration, speed, torque, hydraulic pressure, hydraulic flow, and electrical/electronic sensors.
Document machine performance, observed issues, parts installation/removal, test request completion, and other test activity in timely and accurate reports.
Assist with troubleshooting machine, component, and system issues and support root-cause investigation in collaboration with experienced engineers and cross-functional team members.
Support inspection, repair, rework, and updates of production and pre-production equipment to maintain test readiness and keep machines current with design changes.
Work with platform, design, manufacturing, marketing, commercial, and test organizations to share observations and support product development activities.
Interact professionally with dealers, farmers, customer sites, and CNH commercial representatives while supporting adequate test coverage, prototype confidentiality, and a positive company image.
Follow applicable safety procedures, transport requirements, site expectations, and compliance practices when working around prototype machines, support vehicles, tools, and test equipment.
Experience Required
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, agricultural engineering, technology, agriculture, or a related technical discipline.
Basic understanding of mechanical, hydraulic, electrical/electronic, software-controlled, or off-road vehicle systems.
Ability to travel to domestic and international test locations for field-test assignments, including seasonal travel as required. (up to 50% travel in up to 4 week increments).
Qualified or willing to become qualified to operate company vehicles and support equipment >26,000 GCWR (Willing/able to obtain CDL).
Preferred Qualifications
The ideal candidate will have:
Relevant experience in test, validation, product development, field evaluation, equipment operation, or a related technical environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly document observations, issues, test activity, and follow-up items.
Interest in harvesting equipment, agricultural machinery, construction equipment, off-road vehicles, or related mobile equipment.
Basic knowledge of vehicle systems such as hydraulics, powertrain, electrical/electronic systems, controls, HVAC, or software-controlled functions.
Familiarity with sensing, instrumentation, data acquisition, measurement techniques, or engineering test methods.
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams while learning from experienced engineers, technicians, and product specialists.
Basic understanding of CAN bus, machine controls, diagnostics, or troubleshooting methods is preferred.
Interest in agriculture, harvesting technology, customer needs, machine performance, and product value.
Ability to manage assigned tasks, ask questions when clarification is needed, recognize roadblocks, and escalate issues appropriately.
Willingness to learn, take direction, solve problems, and develop technical judgment through hands-on field and lab validation experience.
Ability to work independently at remote field locations.

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.
Work You'll Do
As a Project - Consultant, Technical Transformation on the project, you will:
Possess 2-5 years of Salesforce development experience to design, build, and maintain Salesforce solutions.
Work on Salesforce Flows, creating and managing sharing/permission models, and developing custom functionality using Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
Implementing process automations, building scalable custom solutions, and collaborating with team members to interpret and translate business requirements into technical capabilities.
Demonstrate proficiency with Salesforce security and object model setup.
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others
The Team
Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.
Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.
The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.
Qualifications
Required
:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
2-5+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
Experience with Salesforce development to design, build, and maintain Salesforce solutions.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
Must be a US Citizen U.S. with the ability to obtain a security clearance
Ability to travel 20-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. description_preview:
As a Full Stack Engineer Senior Consultant in Deloitte Cyber's Digital Trust & Privacy practice, you will operate at the intersection of client-facing advisory, product engineering, and hands-on technical delivery. You will help clients address complex challenges across digital trust, online protection, privacy, artificial intelligence governance, and data protection by translating business and regulatory requirements into scalable, production-grade technology solutions.
Full Stack Engineers work directly in client environments to architect, build, integrate, deploy, and improve solutions. Depending on the engagement, you may develop trust and safety capabilities, implement product compliance controls, operationalize privacy-by-design practices, build governance for generative or agentic AI, or deploy data protection and cryptographic solutions. These capabilities support Deloitte's broader Digital Trust & Privacy mission: helping organizations build confidence in their digital products, platforms, services, data practices, and customer interactions.
This role is designed for a technically strong consultant who can move from ambiguity to implementation, collaborate with product and engineering teams, and communicate effectively with business, security, privacy, legal, and compliance stakeholders.
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.
Work you'll do
As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth and Transformation on the Digital Trust & Privacy team, you will be responsible for:
Translating client business objectives, risk requirements, and policy expectations into technical architectures, product requirements, engineering backlogs, and implementation plans
Designing, developing, integrating, deploying, testing, and troubleshooting production-grade solutions in client environments, including artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI (GenAI)-enabled capabilities where applicable
Building application programming interfaces (APIs), automations, workflows, integrations, dashboards, and other technical components that enable scalable digital trust, privacy, and data protection capabilities
Embedding governance into software development and deployment workflows through automated checkpoints, controls-as-code, policy enforcement, and continuous monitoring
Collaborating with clients and cross-functional stakeholders to prototype solutions, resolve technical issues, and deliver solutions that meet regulatory and program objectives
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others
The team
Deloitte Cyber's Digital Trust & Privacy practice helps organizations build and sustain confidence in their digital products, platforms, services, data practices, and customer experiences. Our work brings together digital trust, online protection, privacy, AI governance, identity, data protection, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance capabilities.
The Full Stack Engineer team is a multidisciplinary engineering group that turns these capabilities into practical solutions. We work alongside client product, engineering, security, privacy, data, risk, compliance, and business teams to move from strategy and policy to implementation and measurable outcomes.
Our work may include:
Helping digital platforms improve trust and safety and address online harms
Enabling product teams to meet privacy and product compliance expectations
Building technical governance and guardrails for generative and agentic AI
Protecting sensitive data across cloud, collaboration, application, and enterprise environments
Implementing data discovery, classification, data loss prevention (DLP), encryption, public key infrastructure (PKI), and related cryptographic capabilities
Developing Deloitte products and accelerators that make complex digital trust and privacy capabilities easier to deploy and operate
Qualifications
Required:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent demonstrated experience
4+ years of experience translating client requirements into solution architectures using Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces, microservices, event-driven architectures, or serverless components
4+ years of experience building and deploying production-grade solutions using Python, Java, or Node.js, and 1+ years of experience delivering solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including containers, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and version control tools
6 months+ of experience designing or deploying generative artificial intelligence (AI) or large language model (LLM) solutions in a client or production environment
Experience in one or more of the following: digital trust and online protection, trust and safety, security, product compliance, privacy, AI governance, data protection, or cryptography
Ability to travel 25-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
Preferred:
Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Next.js for application or demo development
Experience developing or deploying technical controls for generative AI, LLM, or agentic AI applications
Experience with human oversight controls, tool access controls, prompt-injection mitigations, logging, monitoring, or controls-as-code
Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or public sector env

description_preview:
Your Job
The Senior LLM Engineer will fine-tune and deploy LLMs on Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry to power generative AI capabilities within our engineering design platform, translating natural-language design intent into structured, engineering-valid outputs.
Our Team
Established in 1938, Molex delivers comprehensive electronic solutions for various markets, including data communications, telecommunications, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, commercial vehicle, aerospace and defense, medical, and lighting. You'll join the platform team behind our Azure AI/ML engineering tools, working alongside ML engineers, data scientists, and MLOps teams to keep training and inference workloads reliable, secure, and cost-efficient.
What You Will Do
Fine-tune foundation models (LoRA/QLoRA, RLHF/DPO, instruction tuning) for domain-specific tasks and terminology.
Build agentic and tool-use workflows that connect the LLM to internal engineering tools and data sources.
Design evaluation harnesses for factuality and accuracy; own hallucination and safety guardrails.
Build RAG pipelines (Azure AI Search) and structured tool-use/function-calling systems on top of fine-tuned Azure OpenAI models.
Deploy and optimize inference (quantization, KV-cache, vLLM/TensorRT-LLM) on Azure Kubernetes Service for cost-efficient serving.
Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
8+ years overall ML/AI engineering experience, with deep hands-on LLM/foundation model work — not just calling APIs.
Demonstrated experience fine-tuning models (LoRA/QLoRA/PEFT, full fine-tuning, or pretraining at some scale).
Practical experience with alignment techniques (RLHF, RLAIF, DPO, or instruction tuning).
Strong Python and deep PyTorch proficiency; solid grasp of transformer architecture internals.
Hands-on experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings/vector search, and agentic or tool-use LLM systems.
Familiarity with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry or an equivalent cloud LLM platform.
What Will Put You Ahead
Direct experience with Azure OpenAI Service and Azure AI Foundry for enterprise-scale deployment.
Experience orchestrating LLM-driven code or structured-output generation for technical/engineering domains.
Distributed training experience across multi-GPU/multi-node clusters (DeepSpeed, FSDP).
Publications, blog posts, or open-source contributions in generative AI.
For this role, we anticipate paying $195,000- $255,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.
At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.
Hiring Philosophy
All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.
Who We Are
As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before.
At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.
Our Benefits
Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.
Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.
Equal Opportunities
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. reject_reason: Title disqualified: Sr. Software Engineer - Applied AI
description_preview:
Why Join GEICO?
At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.
Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.
Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.
Sr. Software Engineer – Applied AI
Position Summary
GEICO is seeking an experienced Sr. Software Engineer to join our Unified Communications Service Engineering (UCSE) group and lead the development of cutting-edge AI product development. This role is ideal for candidates with deep expertise in building products powered by AI models, with a particular focus on working with large language models (LLMs). You will help drive our insurance business transformation as we transition from a traditional IT model to a tech organization by designing, developing, and deploying core consumer experiences that leverage AI, ensuring they are robust, scalable and production ready.
Position Description
The Unified Communication Service Engineering team is transitioning disparate customer communication touchpoints into a world class services company by building the foundational voice, chat, text, email and core contact center experiences for sales, service and claims operations used by 20,000 GEICO contact center agents, field adjusters and sales representatives sell, endorse, and service more than 80 million customers and prospective customers.
Our Sr. Software Engineer is a lead member of the engineering team working across the organization to build delightful and friction-less product experience for our customers and drive transformative change in the industry by harnessing the power of Generative AI. Our team thrives and succeeds in delivering high-quality products and services in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly. The ideal candidate has broad and deep technical knowledge, typically ranging from front-end UIs through back-end systems and all points in between.
Position Responsibilities
As a Senior Engineer - Applied AI, you will:
Identify AI opportunities: Evaluate and prioritize opportunities to automate business processes using AI, intelligent workflows, and agent-based systems.
Design and ship applied AI solutions: Architect, build, and deploy AI solutions for high-value workflows including automation, document intelligence, decision support, and intelligent assistants.
Build agentic workflows: Design and implement AI agents and agentic workflows that orchestrate tools, APIs, reasoning steps, and business logic to automate complex processes at scale.
Own production systems end-to-end: Develop, deploy, and operate services that meet high standards for scalability, resilience, performance, security, and availability, taking ownership from design through production support.
Leverage knowledge graphs: Use knowledge graphs to enhance reasoning, entity relationships, context retrieval, and multi-step workflows.
Partner across functions: Collaborate with product, engineering, operations, and analytics partners to co-create scalable AI solutions and translate business needs into robust technical designs.
Mentor and upskill others: Coach engineers and scientists in AI, LLMs, and agentic workflow design through pairing, reviews, and architectural guidance.
Drive innovation: Explore new models, frameworks, and reasoning techniques and apply them thoughtfully to real-world challenges.
Influence architecture: Provide technical guidance on architecture, experimentation, and deployment within and across teams.
Experiment and evaluate rigorously: Run end-to-end experimentation, including hypothesis definition, measurement, validation, and iterative improvement in production environments.
Model best practices: Establish and promote engineering best practices for reliability, interpretability, safety, governance, and monitoring of production AI systems.
What We Are Looking For (Must Have)
Experience: 4+ years of professional software engineering or applied machine learning experience, including 1+ years working with Generative AI or LLM-based systems in production.
Hands-on AI engineering: Strong experience with Python and modern AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, and OpenAI or Anthropic APIs.
Production AI delivery: Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating production AI systems, including agentic workflows and intelligent automation features.
Systems engineering excellence: Proven track record building scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable systems that run reliably in production.
AI & data architectures: Strong understanding of agent architectures, workflow orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, and knowledge graph integration.
Cross-functional collaboration: Ability to work deeply with engineers, product managers, and domain experts to co-create solutions.
Mentorship: Experience mentoring engineers and helping others grow in AI, LLM, and agent-based system design.
Business impact: History of delivering measurable business outcomes with AI solutions.
Distributed systems fundamentals: Solid competency in distributed systems, service design, performance optimization, and reliability engineering.
Nice to Have
Advanced GenAI capabilities: Experience building domain-tuned LLMs, vector reasoning techniques, or specialized retrieval architectures.
Regulated domains: Experience in insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries.
Java ecosystem: Experience deploying AI components in Java ecosystems

description_preview:
About the Organization RENK America is a leading supplier in the defense, marine and industry sector with superior mobility, propulsion and drive train solutions. Our tradition is centered on precision-engineered systems for maximum impact, efficiency and endurance. RENK's ambition is to support each and every one of its customers to exceed standards in harsh conditions and combat situations. RENK America employs over 500 employees at our US locations in Muskegon, Michigan, Cincinnati, Ohio, Camby, Indiana and Roseville, Michigan. RENK America is driven by this sense of pride and purpose in our country and our community. Description
The Transmission Mechanical Engineer will be responsible for the design of transmissions and gear boxes for military ground vehicles including tanks, howitzers, and infantry fighting vehicles. Projects will include the full scope of product development including research, design, prototyping, and testing of functional improvements. This engineer will report to the Director of Transmission Engineering, and will perform their job duties with the oversight of a Project Engineer.
Essential Functions
Responsible for mechanical sub system design, including analysis, integration, and performance evaluation in combat vehicle applications.
Develop innovative technical concepts and perform mechanical, hydraulic, and thermal analysis to ensure new designs meet requirements.
Develop & release detailed CAD models and drawings for qualification and production release using Engineering Change Proposals.
Work in a cross-functional environment including interfacing with program management, project engineering, test engineering, analysts, designers, and electrical/controls engineering. Also includes interfacing with customers and suppliers.
Compose design verification test plans that capture all performance data to assess new design requirements compliance.
Oversee qualification activities including bench, dynamometer, and vehicle level testing.
Participate in root cause failure analysis investigations on mechanical systems.
Supports new products/processes and implements operational plans that have measurable impact on business or functional results.
Analyzes mechanical requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints.
Prepares mechanical design information and reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends.
Supports investigations involving the origination or modification of material, component or process specifications or requirements.
Supports preparation of design specifications, analysis and recommendations for presentation and approval.
Consolidates results of mechanical design elements for assigned projects.
Make improvements in processes, systems, or products.
Prepares design specifications, analysis and recommendations for presentation and approval.
Maintain existing product design including support of TDP, production and supply chain support.
Level / pay for this position will be commensurate with education & experience.
Position Requirements
Bachelor of Science (BS) in Mechanical Engineering from an accredited university required with 0-8 years of relevant experience (Including new college graduates)
Ability to perform engineering calculations such as mechanical stress, structural, thermal fluids, and heat transfer.
Knowledge of mechanical systems and components such as gears, shafts, pumps, and bearings.
Problem solving and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to participate in and lead failure analysis investigations.
GD&T knowledge, including the ability to create and read machining and assembly prints
Creo or other CAD modeling software experience.
Ability to make technical decisions, complete assignments within budget and schedule, and work with minimal supervision.
Ability to manage and organize multiple project tasks to meet established deadlines, including tracking metrics and reporting status of engineering activities.
Excellent written and verbal communications.
Ability to utilize all Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project.
Must be willing to travel (domestic and foreign) up to 10%.
Must be able to move freely, with or without reasonable accommodation, throughout a manufacturing environment.
Must be capable of obtaining a DOD security clearance if necessary for the program.
Preferred Additional Skills
Previous experience with transmission or gear box components and concepts such as:
Hydraulic systems, control valves, and pumps
Gears, planetary sets, bearings, clutches, brakes, structural housings, and shafts
Geartrain performance parameters such as speed, torque, power, and gear ratio.
Integration into a vehicle and performance evaluation
MS in Mechanical Engineering (or other advanced degree).
Systems engineering experience
Hybrid vehicle experience
